units.source_text: 那时候，玩将棋还是很热闹的。

en.t: At that time, playing shogi was still quite lively.

units.source_text: 可自从名人一再患病之后，连消遣比赛中也仿佛笼罩着一种阴森的气氛。

en.t: But after the Master repeatedly fell ill, even the casual matches seemed to be shrouded in a gloomy atmosphere.

units.source_text: 在八月十日对局之后，名人已活像冥府里的人了，但仍然不得不去参加比赛。

en.t: After the match on August 10, the Master already looked like someone from the underworld, yet he still had no choice but to take part in the games.
